claim: For the antiferromagnetic two-qubit Hamiltonian of Chen and Yin, \[H=J(\sigma_x\otimes\sigma_x+\sigma_y\otimes\sigma_y)+J_z\sigma_z\otimes\sigma_z+D_z(\sigma_x\otimes\sigma_y-\sigma_y\otimes\sigma_x),\]with \(J>0\), \(J_z>0\), \(D_z\in\mathbb R\), define \(R=\sqrt{J^2+D_z^2}\). For every positive temperature \(T\), the Gibbs state is locally unitarily equivalent to a Bell-diagonal state with two equal transverse correlation magnitudes \(c_\perp\) and longitudinal magnitude \(c_z\). Their exact ordering is temperature independent: \[|c_z|-|c_\perp|=\frac{2e^{-J_z/T}}{Z}\left(e^{2(J_z-R)/T}-1\right).\]Hence the projective measurement maximizing the classical correlation, and therefore minimizing the quantum discord, is longitudinal exactly when \(J_z>R\), transverse exactly when \(J_z<R\), and degenerate over all axes when \(J_z=R\). If \(J_z>J\), the optimizer switches at the exact DM strength \[|D_z|=\sqrt{J_z^2-J^2},\]independently of temperature; if \(J_z\le J\), no nontrivial switch occurs. In addition, writing \(\mathcal D(T)\) for the base-2 quantum discord, \[\lim_{T\to\infty}T^2\mathcal D(T)=\begin{cases}\dfrac{R^2}{\ln2},&J_z\ge R,\\[4pt]\dfrac{R^2+J_z^2}{2\ln2},&J_z\le R.\end{cases}\]The two branches agree at \(J_z=R\). This gives an exact analytic optimizer phase boundary and the leading high-temperature decay constant behind the source's numerical observation that thermal discord remains nonzero at every finite temperature but approaches zero asymptotically.

scientific_limitations: Applies to the source's Dz interaction without external fields and with J>0, Jz>0.
Concerns standard one-sided projective-measurement quantum discord.
The asymptotic statement gives the leading T^-2 coefficient; higher terms are not classified.
An equivalent Bell-diagonal specialization may exist in unindexed or differently parameterized literature.
title: Temperature-independent discord optimizer boundary in the XXZ–DM dimer
